{{Short description|British virologist (born 1931)}}
'''Bryan Desmond Harrison''' [[CBE]], [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (born 16 June 1931) is a British [[virologist]], and professor emeritus at the [[University of Dundee]].<ref>http://www.debretts.co.uk/people/biographies/browse/h/15036/Bryan%20Desmond+HARRISON.aspx{{dead link|date=November 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

==Works==
*Adrian J. Gibbs, Bryan D. Harrison, ''Plant virology: the principles'', Wiley, 1976, {{ISBN|978-0-470-15040-5}}
*Bryan D. Harrison, A. F. Murant (eds) ''Polyhedral virions and bipartite RNA genomes'', Plenum Press, 1996, {{ISBN|978-0-306-45225-3}}
*Michael W. Bevan, Bryan D. Harrison, C. J. Leaver (eds) ''The production and uses of genetically transformed plants'', Chapman & Hall, 1994, {{ISBN|978-0-412-60060-9}}
